title: Princeton Digital Group
bottom_line: PDG's five old enterprise sites came from XL Axiata in 2019 through a joint venture, PT Princeton Digital Group Data Centres, in which XL kept 14.82% after 2022; on 12 Oct 2026 PDG agreed to sell those sites to Sinar Mas's SM+. Its hyperscale arm, PT Princeton Digital Group, owns JC2 and paid Sinarmas Land's Puradelta Lestari about Rp618 bn for the JC3 and JC4 land in GIIC, so Sinar Mas both sold PDG its new land and is buying its old sites. Power comes from estate grids and PLN, not PDG's own plants (Cikarang Listrindo at Cibitung with up to 20% biomass from a coal co-firing plant, a PLN bay of up to 200 MVA at GI Sukamahi for JC3, Tamarin and PLN Batam for the unbuilt Batam campus), and no builder or equipment maker is named for any Indonesian site.

entities.name: Princeton Digital Group (PDG)
entities.what: Singapore-based data-centre developer and operator, set up in 2017-18 by Rangu Salgame and Varoon Raghavan with Warburg Pincus. It reports 1.8 GW+ across Asia. Its 2025-26 report gives Indonesia as Jakarta 388 MW, other sites 12 MW and Batam 96 MW, mostly planned.

entities.name: PDG (Indonesia Alpha)
entities.legal_name: Princeton Digital Group (Indonesia Alpha) Pte. Ltd.
entities.what: Singapore holding company that bought XL Axiata's shares in PT Princeton Digital Group Data Centres and held 85.18% of it after the Aug 2022 capital increase.

entities.name: PDG Data Centres (PDGDC)
entities.legal_name: PT Princeton Digital Group Data Centres
entities.what: Joint venture formed in 2019 to hold XL Axiata's five data centres. Paid-up capital was Rp1.35 tn after Aug 2022: Indonesia Alpha 85.18%, XL 14.82%. Probably the holder of the five enterprise sites PDG agreed to sell to SM+ in Oct 2026, though no source names the entity sold.

entities.name: PT Princeton Digital Group
entities.what: PDG's Indonesian company for its new hyperscale campuses. It borrowed the IDR 1.7 tn JC2 green loan (2025) and bought GIIC land from Puradelta Lestari for Rp171.5 bn (Q3 2024) and Rp446.1 bn (Q2 2026). Its shareholders, and whether it is separate from PDGDC, are not public.

entities.name: JC1 Cibitung
entities.what: Operating data centre at Jl. Sumbawa No.1, Mekarwangi, on the same 19,550 m2 campus as JC2. It is almost certainly XL Axiata's former Cibitung site: XLSmart lists a facility, 'XLSmart Cibitung (JNB2)', at the same street address. It is one of the five ID1 enterprise sites (11 MW for all five) and is in the SM+ sale signed 12 Oct 2026, which has not closed.

entities.name: JB1 Bintaro
entities.what: Operating ex-XL enterprise data centre, one of PDG's five ID1 sites. It was a pilot site for HVO fuel, got a new HVAC system in 2025 (510 kg of refrigerant recovered), and is in the SM+ sale (not closed).

entities.name: BD1 Bandung
entities.what: Operating ex-XL enterprise data centre at Jl. Soekarno Hatta No.779, Bandung, one of PDG's five ID1 sites. It is covered by PLN geothermal RECs (2023), got a new HVAC system in 2025, and is in the SM+ sale (not closed).

entities.name: SB1 Surabaya
entities.what: Operating ex-XL enterprise data centre at Jl. Raya Rungkut Industri II No.15, Surabaya, one of PDG's five ID1 sites. It got a new HVAC system in 2025 and is in the SM+ sale (not closed).

entities.name: PDG Pekanbaru
entities.what: Operating ex-XL enterprise data centre in Pekanbaru (code and address not found), one of PDG's five ID1 sites. It is covered by PLN geothermal RECs (2023) and is in the SM+ sale (not closed).

entities.name: JC2 Cibitung
entities.what: 22 MW hyperscale data centre at Jl. Sumba Blok A-B Kav. B12-1, MM2100. It was announced in Aug 2021 (US$150 m) and opened on 25 Sep 2023. It holds BCA Green Mark Platinum, PUE is under 1.40, and an IDR 1.7 tn green club loan (2025) finances it. PDG keeps it.

entities.name: JC3 GIIC
entities.what: 120 MW AI-ready campus, US$1 bn, 25 km from JC2. Ground was broken on 19 Nov 2025 and the first phase is due for service in Q4 2026 (not yet confirmed live). Hybrid air and liquid cooling, up to 140 kW per rack, with dual PLN feeds. Under construction.

entities.name: JC4 GIIC
entities.what: Planned 240 MW campus: four 60 MW buildings on 106,217 m2 of 'powered land' 1.7 km from JC3, sharing JC3's power and connectivity. Bought in Apr 2026; PDG says construction has started.

entities.name: PDG Nongsa campus (Batam)
entities.city: Nongsa, Batam (Nongsa Digital Park, KEK Nongsa)
entities.what: Planned 96 MW campus: four 24 MW buildings on 15 acres (about 6 ha) in Nongsa Digital Park, about US$1 bn (Rp14.46 tn). Announced 20 Feb 2023 under PDG's 'SG+' plan; power 'fully secured'. No construction or opening confirmed by Oct 2026; local press says '120 MW reported' as of Jan 2026.

entities.name: Warburg Pincus
entities.what: US private-equity firm that set up PDG with its founders in 2017. PDG called it its 'largest institutional investor' in 2020 and said in Jul 2025 that it 'will continue to be PDG's largest shareholder'. Stake % not public.

entities.name: Ontario Teachers'
entities.what: Canadian pension fund. It led PDG's US$360 m equity round (Oct 2020) and invested again in the Feb 2022 round.

entities.name: Mubadala
entities.what: Abu Dhabi state investor. It led PDG's US$500 m+ equity round with US$350 m (Feb 2022).

entities.name: Stonepeak
entities.what: Infrastructure investor. US$1.3 bn preferred equity in PDG, announced 18 Jul 2025 and closed 8 Aug 2025.

entities.name: XL Axiata (now XLSmart)
entities.legal_name: PT XLSmart Telecom Sejahtera Tbk (formerly PT XL Axiata Tbk)
entities.what: Telco. In 2019 it sold PDG 70% of its five data centres (a JV, PDGDC) and leases back part of them. Its stake fell to 14.82% after Aug 2022. On PeeringDB it lists a facility, 'XLSmart Cibitung (JNB2)', at JC1's street address.

entities.name: SM+
entities.what: Sinar Mas's (DSSA) edge and metro data-centre platform: 25 facilities in 24 cities, about 40 MW (DSSA 2025). On 12 Oct 2026 it agreed to buy PDG's five enterprise data centres, taking it to 31 sites in 25 cities; UBS advises SM+.

entities.name: DSSA (Dian Swastatika Sentosa)
entities.what: IDX-listed Sinar Mas energy and infrastructure company. It owns 99.999% of SM+ through PT DSST Mas Gemilang. Its main shareholder is PT Sinar Mas Tunggal (59.90%).

entities.name: MM2100 estate (PT MMID)
entities.what: Developer of the MM2100 Industrial Town, set up in 1990 by Marubeni and the Manunggal Group. The estate's electricity comes from Cikarang Listrindo. JC1 and JC2 sit in it.

entities.name: Marubeni
entities.what: Japanese trading house; co-founder of the MM2100 estate developer (1990).

entities.name: Manunggal Group
entities.what: Indonesian group; co-founder of the MM2100 estate developer with Marubeni (1990).

entities.name: Puradelta Lestari (Kota Deltamas / GIIC)
entities.what: IDX-listed developer of Kota Deltamas and the GIIC estate. Its data-centre zone covers about 300 ha, with up to 993 MVA from PLN and 15 data-centre tenants. Owners: PT Sumber Arusmulia (Sinarmas Land) 57.28%, Sojitz 25%. It sold land to PT Princeton Digital Group in 2024 and 2026.

entities.name: Sinarmas Land
entities.what: Sinar Mas property arm. It owns 100% of PT Sumber Arusmulia, which holds 57.28% of Puradelta Lestari (GIIC).

entities.name: Sojitz
entities.what: Japanese trading house; has held 25% of Puradelta Lestari (GIIC developer) since 1996.

entities.name: Nongsa Digital Park (Tamarin)
entities.what: Citramas Group company that manages KEK Nongsa / Nongsa Digital Park. It runs the park's own local power grid, fed by PLN Batam and Maxpower Indonesia.

entities.name: Citramas Group
entities.what: Batam property group; parent of PT Taman Resor Internet (Nongsa Digital Park).

entities.name: Cikarang Listrindo
entities.what: IDX-listed private power producer that supplies the MM2100 estate. Since Aug 2023 it has sold PDG biomass-sourced power for up to 20% of the Cibitung campus, plus biomass I-RECs. Its biomass-capable plant is the 280 MW PLTU Co-firing Babelan, which can co-fire 70 MW of biomass.

entities.name: PLN
entities.what: State electricity company. It feeds JC3 with dual 150 kV feeds (a bay of up to 200 MVA, energised Sep 2026), and PDG was the first corporate buyer of its RECs (Kamojang geothermal, from 2020).

entities.name: GI 150 kV Data Center / Sukamahi
entities.what: PLN 150 kV customer substation for the GIIC data centres. Bay KTT 10 / Line UGC 2 serves PDG JC3 (up to 200 MVA, energised Sep 2026). Probably the 'KTT Data Center' substation Elsewedy contracted to build in 2024.

entities.name: Elsewedy Electric Indonesia
entities.what: Electrical contractor; signed with PLN in Jan 2024 to build the 150 kV 'KTT Data Center' substation at GIIC (US$12.6 m: transformers and civil works).

entities.name: PLTP Kamojang
entities.what: PLN geothermal plant (140 MW), registered in Nov 2020 to issue PLN's renewable energy certificates. It is the source of PDG's RECs for its Jakarta, Bandung and Pekanbaru sites.

entities.name: PLN Batam
entities.what: Batam's electricity company. Under an Oct 2022 MoU it supplies Tamarin's KEK Nongsa network for data centres.

entities.name: Maxpower Indonesia
entities.what: Power producer named by Tamarin as the second supply source, after PLN Batam, for KEK Nongsa's data centres.

entities.name: Pertamina Patra Niaga
entities.what: Downstream subholding of state oil company Pertamina. It supplies HVO to replace diesel in PDG's Indonesian backup generators (agreement Sep 2025, after pilots at JC2 and JB1).

entities.name: Recoolit
entities.what: Indonesian refrigerant-recovery company. PDG used it when it replaced the HVAC systems at JB1, BD1 and SB1 (1,019 tCO2e avoided).

entities.name: Waste4Change
entities.what: Indonesian waste-management company running PDG's waste programme across its Indonesian sites from 2026.

entities.name: EPI Group
entities.what: Data-centre certification body. It awarded JC1 and JC2 TIA-942 Rated-3 design certificates (Mar 2022).

entities.name: BCA Singapore (Green Mark)
entities.what: Singapore agency whose Green Mark scheme rated JC2 Platinum.

entities.name: DBS
entities.legal_name: DBS Bank Ltd (PT Bank DBS Indonesia in Indonesia)
entities.what: Bank. Through PT Bank DBS Indonesia it co-arranged the IDR 1.7 tn JC2 green club loan (2025); it also co-underwrote the US$456 m JC3 facility (2026).

entities.name: UOB Indonesia
entities.what: Bank; co-arranged the IDR 1.7 tn JC2 green club loan with Bank DBS Indonesia, both acting as green loan coordinators (Mar 2025).

entities.name: HSBC
entities.what: Bank; co-underwrote the US$456 m JC3 green syndicated facility (May 2026).

entities.name: Maybank
entities.what: Bank; co-underwrote the US$456 m JC3 green syndicated facility (May 2026).

entities.name: SMBC
entities.what: Bank; co-underwrote the US$456 m JC3 green syndicated facility (May 2026).

entities.name: Standard Chartered
entities.what: Bank; co-underwrote the US$456 m JC3 green syndicated facility (May 2026).

entities.name: APJII
entities.what: Indonesian ISP association that runs the Indonesia Internet Exchange (IIX). PDG partnership since Apr 2022.

entities.name: BP Batam
entities.what: Batam free-zone authority. Its chairman welcomed PDG's 96 MW Nongsa project (Feb 2023).

entities.name: Rangu Salgame
entities.what: Co-founder, Chairman and CEO of PDG. PDG's bio says he worked earlier at Tata Communications, Cisco Systems and Verizon, and is a board director of BCIU.

entities.name: Varoon Raghavan
entities.what: Co-founder and Chief Operating Officer of PDG; earlier at Tata Communications (PDG bio).

entities.name: Frederic Daniel Van Husen
entities.what: PDG's General Manager, Indonesia (2026); earlier led DKSH's technology business in Indonesia (PDG bio).

entities.name: Stephanus Tumbelaka
entities.what: Managing Director of PDG Indonesia in PDG releases from Jun 2020 to Aug 2023. He fronted the PLN REC, APJII, EPI and Cikarang Listrindo deals.

entities.name: Niall Hannigan
entities.what: PDG's Chief Financial Officer; quoted on the JC2 green loan (2025). Earlier CFO of Masdar for 14 years (PDG bio).

entities.name: Dian Siswarini
entities.what: President Director and CEO of XL Axiata when it sold 70% of its data centres to PDG (2019) and cut its stake (2022).

entities.name: Herson Suindah
entities.what: President Director and Group CEO of SM+ Holdings (2026); announced the purchase of PDG's enterprise data centres.

entities.name: Franky Oesman Widjaja
entities.what: Controls PT Sinar Mas Tunggal, DSSA's main shareholder (59.90%), per DSSA's 2025 annual report.

entities.name: Margaretha Natalia Widjaja
entities.what: Named by Puradelta Lestari (GIIC developer) as holding its ultimate ownership and control (2025).

entities.name: Matius Sugiaman
entities.what: Commercial Director of PT Cikarang Listrindo Tbk (2023); announced the PDG biomass contract.

entities.name: Alimuddin Baso
entities.what: Director of Central Marketing & Trading at PT Pertamina Patra Niaga (2025); announced the HVO deal with PDG.

entities.name: Michael Kristian Wiluan
entities.what: President Director (Direktur Utama) of PT Taman Resor Internet (Tamarin), the Nongsa Digital Park manager (2022).
